panel_text:
FAQ
If you'd rather connect with our community, chat and ask your questions there, you can do so here!
Discord
If not, enjoy reading through this amazing FAQ, beautifully crafted and put together by Taulion!
"How do I get a new job?"
Remember that you're only allowed to have one job at a time!
New job locations are unlocked as you play through the game.
Currently, there's locations for jobs in almost any hub. Hubs are places with a lot of buildings, i.e the City, Uptown, Downtown, Streets and so forth. Check out the buildings while being unemployed to find new jobs.
"My character is such a prude!"
That's not a question, but you could try to lower her inhibition!
"I've got no inhibition, how do I unlock more scenes?"
Some content unlocks as you raise your other stats and make progress with the main questline.
Some side-content requires additional items available in the mall.
"How do the other stats work?"
Corruption: This shows the current corruption of the character. It will increase with lewd acts, as well as open up for more scenes!
Allure: This shows how much the character is desired by others. This will increase the chance of non consensual encounters!
Arousal: This shows how much of a horndog you are.
"Why can't I go to the alley or lake?"
Explore the locations already available to you. There might be events that you've missed.
Remember that some activities can be tried multiple times, and might change as you increase your stats.
"How do I go on a date?"
You can contact characters using a phone, available at the mall. Later, some dates can be started from a character's room.
"I raised my relationship with a character, how do I progress further in this relationship?"
You can only go on dates for now. More relationship content will be added in future updates!
"How do I progess with story?"
Story progresses itself rather autonomous, all you have to do is be available and talk to the characters that is guaranteed to come speak to you. Some parts of the story only trigger if you're in the right places, i.e the mansion or the Street.
"I have unlocked the church, can I see the brothel, too?"
The story is path determined, so no. You'll have to restart.
"I'm trapped with Tim!"
Too bad.

It is Monday, Morning, Day 1.
As you walk further downtown, you notice there's a club here, a mall, and a library. This place could be exciting. Neon lights flicker above the club entrance, distant music thumping through the walls like a heartbeat. The mall sprawls across a few blocks, its glass doors glinting in the afternoon sun, promising shops, food, and maybe answers. The library stands quiet and grand, ivy climbing its stone facade - a strange contrast to the rest of the street's energy.
Just past the corner, a small cinema marquee catches your eye. Its retro signage glows faintly, advertising movies you've never heard of. There's something oddly timeless about it, as if it hasn't changed in decades. You get the feeling each of these places holds a different kind of secret.
You pause, the streets unusually empty despite the signs of life. Where do you go first?
Go back

panel_text:
It is Monday, Morning, Day 1.
As you walk further uptown, you notice a bar, a beauty salon, and a car dealership. Perhaps some of those could come in handy at some point? The bar is tucked between two brick buildings, its sign half-lit and swaying slightly in the breeze - the kind of place where locals might trade stories... or secrets. The beauty salon next door gleams with soft lighting and the faint scent of hairspray and lavender drifting out when the door opens. It feels oddly pristine, like it's waiting for someone - maybe you.
Across the street, rows of shiny vehicles line the lot of a small car dealership. The place looks quiet, but not abandoned. A figure moves behind the tinted glass of the office. There's something about the way the cars reflect the sky - polished, but still... off.
Everything here seems useful, but nothing feels quite normal.
Where to next?
Go back

Blessed are the unshackled, for they walk unburdened by the weight of false virtue.

The world would have you believe in chains-chains of duty, of guilt, of whispered warnings passed down by trembling lips too afraid to taste true freedom. They call it morality, but it is nothing more than fear wrapped in doctrine, a cage disguised as a home.

But you, reader, are no fool. You have opened these pages not to be told what is right, but to see what is true. And the truth is this: there is no sin but the denial of desire. No crime but the refusal of pleasure. No virtue greater than the will to take what is yours.

Turn the page, if you dare. Let the gospel guide you home.

You find yourself immersed in the world between the pages as your fingers glide gently over the smooth surface of the book. The rustling of turning pages harmonizes with the soft murmurs of distant conversations. Each word seems to come alive, painting vivid pictures in your mind.

The atmosphere envelops you, cocooning you in a sanctuary of knowledge and imagination. Here, within the hushed whispers of countless stories, you discover solace and adventure, and the barriers of time and space fade away.
